# 00000004008

**English.** Definition: The signature null ideal is the set of all signature polynomials that vanish on a given class of paths. Conjecture: The null ideal is generated by an explicit finite set of shuffle quadratic relations together with unit monomials, and the maximal degree of the generators is 2. (quadratic generation of the signature null ideal)

**中文。** 定义：签名核零理想指全体在给定路径类上取零的签名多项式。猜想：零理想由 shuffle 二次关系与单位单项式的显式有限集生成,生成元最高次数为 2。（签名零理想二次生成）
